reason: Mixed case: optional/ordinary field access, member access, nil lifting, grouped expressions, classes, anonymous functions, casts, check/trap and the listed operators are supported. The executed assertions also require error.detail(), cloneReadOnly(), and a range iterator() langlib call, none of which are in the permitted library/method lists. These requirements make the whole case a feature case independent of any failure in supported access expressions. The grouped-expression function additionally uses let, typeof and Elvis expressions, which are not listed in the supported expression inventory.
unsupported_constructs: je.detail(): lang.error supports only message; detail is absent from both library and method-call allowlists.
bool.cloneReadOnly(): absent from lang.value and method-call allowlists.
(1 ..< 5).iterator().next(): range/int iterator is absent from the library and method-call allowlists (only XML iterator is listed).
let expression, typeof expression and Elvis operator (?:): not covered by the supported expression/operator inventories.
test_design_notes: The main function aggregates supported access tests with broader expression/library tests, so a failure cannot by itself identify an access-expression bug.
Eight printed boolean results have matching @output true markers; the closure-mutation test is deliberately checked through panic assertions and emits no output.
No obvious migration or output-marker mismatch is visible in the supplied source.
